# Chanta

> Romanian Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. A family-owned Romanian kitchen on South Hyde Park Avenue, with freshly baked bread and a grandma at the stove.

- Phone: (813) 605-4011
- Address: 113 S Hyde Park Ave, Tampa, FL 33606
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Dinner from the grandma's kitchen; Platters and starters; A sweet finish
- Rating: 4.7 from 963 Google reviews
